[[File:Logs detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Logs''', also called '''normal logs''', are obtained from [[woodcutting|cutting]] [[Regular tree|regular]], [[evergreen tree|evergreen]], [[Jungle tree|jungle]], [[Dying tree|dying]] and [[dead tree]]s, and uncommonly from [[infected root]]s. Players can burn these logs using the [[Firemaking]] [[skill]]. Cutting the logs gives 25 [[Woodcutting]] [[experience]], and burning them gives 40 Firemaking experience. These logs have no requirement to be cut or burnt.

[[Members]] training [[Construction]] can bring logs to a [[sawmill]] to make [[planks]] at a cost of 100 [[coins]] each. Alternatively, the [[Lunar spell]] [[Plank Make]] can allow players to convert them to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of [[runes]].

While wearing [[Kandarin headgear 1]] or higher, normal trees anywhere give double logs when chopped down but no additional experience is provided.

It is currently the only log which can be coloured with [[gnomish firelighters]], which are obtained as rewards from [[Treasure Trails]]. These firelighters produce fire in one of five predetermined colours: red, blue, green, purple, or white. Coloured logs also give 50 Firemaking experience, slightly more than lighting the logs normally.

[[Members]] can also [[fletching|fletch]] these logs into [[bow]]s and [[arrow shaft]]s, and are the only type of log that can be made into [[javelin shaft]]s.

Normal logs are also used to travel to [[Entrana]] or [[Taverley]] using the [[Balloon Transport System]] after completing the [[Enlightened Journey]] quest (they are also required during the quest).

Four normal logs respawn on [[Lumbridge Castle]]'s roof, in a house in [[Draynor Village]], in the [[Wizards' Tower]], and in a house in [[Rimmington]]. They also spawn south of Varlamore.

==Firemaking==
{{Main|Firemaking}}

A player only needs level 1 [[Firemaking]] and a [[tinderbox]] to turn a normal tree's [[logs]] into a [[fire]], granting 40 [[experience]].

The [[infernal axe]] provides a 1/3 chance of burning any log received when cutting trees. The player gains 20 Firemaking experience when cutting trees, half the experience gained from burning the log normally. If the Kandarin headgear 1 or above is worn in conjunction with the infernal axe, only one log is burned when a tree section is cut.

== Construction (Members Skill) ==
{{Main|Construction}}

Logs may be turned into [[plank]]s at a [[Sawmill]] for use in [[Construction]] for 100 [[coins]] each.
Alternatively, the Lunar spell Plank Make can allow players to convert the logs to planks at a lower cost, but at the expense of runes. 

==Fletching (Members Skill)==
{{Main|Fletching}}

[[Logs]] from normal trees can be cut into 15 [[arrow shafts]] at level 1 [[Fletching]] (granting 5 Fletching [[experience]]), 15 [[javelin shaft]]s at level 3 (granting 5 Fletching experience), [[shortbow]]s at level 5 (granting 5 XP for unstrung and another 5 experience for stringing), [[longbow]]s at level 10 (granting 10 experience for unstrung and another 10 experience for stringing), and [[crossbow stock]]s at level 9 (granting 6 experience).
